description: This Java class 'HonoSenderSampler' extends 'HonoSampler' and implements 'ThreadListener', acting as a custom JMeter sampler for sending messages via Hono. It manages configuration properties for message sending, initializes and shuts down a 'HonoSender' instance per thread, and performs message sending during test execution.

classes.name: HonoSenderSampler
classes.description: A JMeter sampler class for sending messages via the Hono platform, supporting configuration of message properties, wait conditions, and thread-safe sender management.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversAsInt
methods.description: Returns the number of receivers to wait for as an integer, defaulting to 0 if parsing fails.

methods.name: getWaitForReceivers
methods.description: Returns the configured property string for the number of receivers to wait for.

methods.name: setWaitForReceivers
methods.description: Sets the property value for the number of receivers to wait for.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversTimeoutAsInt
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds for waiting for receivers as an integer, defaulting to 0.

methods.name: getWaitForReceiversTimeout
methods.description: Gets the property string for the wait timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: setWaitForReceiversTimeout
methods.description: Sets the wait timeout property for receivers in milliseconds.

methods.name: getSendTimeoutOrDefaultAsInt
methods.description: Returns the send timeout as an integer, defaulting to DEFAULT_SEND_TIMEOUT if parsing fails.

methods.name: getSendTimeoutOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the send timeout as a string, defaulting to DEFAULT_SEND_TIMEOUT if empty.

methods.name: setSendTimeout
methods.description: Sets the property for the send timeout.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID property.

methods.name: setDeviceId
methods.description: Sets the device ID property.

methods.name: isSetSenderTime
methods.description: Returns whether the sender time property is set to add timestamp.

methods.name: setSetSenderTime
methods.description: Sets whether to add the current timestamp to messages.

methods.name: isWaitForDeliveryResult
methods.description: Indicates if the sampler should wait for the delivery result.

methods.name: setWaitForDeliveryResult
methods.description: Configures whether to wait for delivery results.

methods.name: getMessageCountPerSamplerRun
methods.description: Returns the message count per sampler run as a string.

methods.name: getMessageCountPerSamplerRunAsInt
methods.description: Returns the message count per run as an integer, with minimum value 1.

methods.name: setMessageCountPerSamplerRun
methods.description: Sets the message count per sampler run property, ensuring it is at least 1.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the MIME content type property.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type property.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the payload data property.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the payload data property.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Performs the sampling operation: initializes result, sends message(s) via 'HonoSender', and returns the sample result.

methods.name: threadStarted
methods.description: Initializes 'HonoSender' when thread starts and waits for receivers if configured. Handles exceptions during sender startup.

methods.name: threadFinished
methods.description: Closes 'HonoSender' when thread finishes, handling exceptions during shutdown.
